<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

# Navigate to [8,32]: UP, UP, RIGHT
result = action(['UP', 'UP', 'RIGHT'])
pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Try DOWN from [8,32]
result = action(['DOWN'])
new_pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"DOWN from [8,32]: -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != (8,32)}")

if new_pos != (8,32):
    pos = new_pos
    print(f"\nNew position: {pos}")
    # Explore from new position
    for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
        result = action([direction])
        new_pos2 = get_player_pos()
        moved = new_pos2 != pos
        print(f"  {direction}: {pos} -> {new_pos2}, moved={moved}")
        if moved:
            pos = new_pos2
else:
    print("DOWN from [8,32] blocked")
    # Try from [8,20]
    result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
    pos = get_player_pos()
    print(f"\nAt {pos}")
    
    result = action(['DOWN'])
    new_pos = get_player_pos()
    print(f"DOWN from [8,20]: -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != (8,20)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
